desc:
⛏️ Start with a rusty old digger and a beat-up tip truck. End up running the biggest mine in the valley.

DIG real terrain. Every bucket changes the ground. Find iron, copper, coal and gold-rich pay-dirt in your own claim.
HAUL loads to the Railyard and watch the cash roll in.
PROCESS it: crush ore, wash gold, pour gold bars and smelt metal for the train.
UPGRADE from an 8-tonne rust bucket to a 120-tonne mining excavator and the Ultra Haul Truck.
HIRE DRIVERS to run your trucks while you keep digging.

🎮 EASY or SIM controls on phone, PC and controller
🚜 36 detailed machines: excavators, dozers, loaders, trucks, utes, low-loaders, belts and fuel trailers
📜 12 leases to unlock, right up to the hard-rock ridge
⛰️ Dig the Mountain Range with your whole server and share the cash
🏆 Weekly leaderboards, event weeks, contracts, rare finds and daily rewards
👷 Crew up with friends to dig, haul and earn together

Your pit saves exactly how you left it. Come back tomorrow and keep digging.
